instagram.caption:
A hacker stole personnel records of thousands of Homeland Security agents — including people working undercover.

The breach hits current and former employees at agencies like Customs and Border Protection and Immigration and Customs Enforcement. 🚨

Some stolen files may expose undercover identities, putting agents and their operations at risk.

If you write about security or government, verify the facts before amplifying names or details that could endanger someone. ⚠️
